RAIT CTF is a cybersecurity competition designed for curious minds, problem solvers, and future security researchers.

It brings together students, professionals, and enthusiasts to tackle real-world inspired challenges, learn new skills, and become part of a growing infosec community.

Same desktop. Different mindset.

About RAIT-CTF

What Is RAIT-CTF?

RAIT CTF is more than just a competition. It is a platform to learn, explore, and challenge yourself in the world of cybersecurity.

Inspired by the past, built for the future.
